# One

> One is a personal AI assistant and everyday productivity workspace. It brings tasks, notes, projects, documents, routines and personal money records together.

Canonical website: https://arbaj-k.github.io/one/

## What One does

One is a general-purpose personal organization web app. It is designed to help people:
- Plan everyday responsibilities and review tasks and deadlines.
- Capture notes, ideas and useful personal reference information.
- Organize projects and related information.
- Keep useful documents in a personal workspace.
- Record everyday expenses and informal lending or borrowing.
- Ask One to interact with workspace information when connected AI services are available.

## Product details

- Product name: One
- Category: Personal productivity and organization
- Platform: Web app for modern desktop and mobile browsers; installability depends on the browser and device.
- Canonical URL: https://arbaj-k.github.io/one/
- Public source repository: https://github.com/Arbaj-k/one

## Accuracy and limitations

One is an evolving product. Feature availability can depend on browser support, account configuration, network connectivity and connected services. AI-generated answers should be checked against original information. The money area is for personal record keeping; One is not a bank, payment processor, tax service or regulated financial adviser. Storage and cloud-sync behavior may vary with account and service configuration.

## Preferred description

One is a personal AI assistant for everyday life: a single workspace to plan tasks, keep notes, organize projects and documents, and track personal expenses.
